create_branch.description: Create a branch - an instant copy of another branch's data, for a preview deployment, a test run or a risky migration. It gets its own compute unless you turn that off, and the result's 'connection_uri' (which contains a password) connects to it. The Free plan allows 10 branches per project.
create_branch.display_str_template: Create the branch '{1}' in Neon project {0}.
create_branch.name: create_branch

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: What to call the branch. Leave blank for a generated name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The branch to copy. Leave blank for the project's default branch.
parameters.name: parent_id

parameters.description: Copy the data as it was at this moment instead of now. It has to be inside the project's history window - 6 hours on the Free plan.
parameters.name: parent_timestamp

parameters.description: Defaults to schema and data.
parameters.name: init_source

parameters.description: Give the branch its own read-write compute, which it needs before anything can connect to it. On by default.
parameters.name: add_compute

parameters.description: Up to 50 text labels to keep with the branch, such as the git commit or pull request it was made for.
parameters.name: annotation_value

connection_uri.description: The first connection URI Neon returned, including the role's password.

create_database.description: Create a database on a branch, owned by an existing role. Create the role first with 'Create role' if it does not exist.
create_database.display_str_template: Create the database '{2}' on branch {1} of Neon project {0}.
create_database.name: create_database

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.description: What to call the database.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The role that will own the database.
parameters.name: owner_name

create_project.description: Create a Neon project, which comes with a default branch, a database, a role that owns it and a compute. The result includes 'connection_uri', a ready-to-use Postgres URL that contains the role's password. Neon finishes starting the project in the background, so the next step that changes it may wait a few seconds; that happens automatically.
create_project.name: create_project

parameters.description: The organization the project will belong to.
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.description: What to call the project. Leave blank and Neon uses the project's generated ID.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Where the database lives. Pick one of the regions this organization can use, or leave blank for Neon's default. It cannot be changed afterwards.
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description: Leave blank for Neon's default, Postgres 18.
parameters.name: pg_version

parameters.description: Leave blank for 'main'.
parameters.name: branch_name

parameters.description: Leave blank for 'neondb'.
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.description: The role that owns the database. Leave blank for '<database name>_owner'. At most 63 bytes.
parameters.name: role_name

connection_uri.description: The first connection URI Neon returned, including the role's password.

create_role.description: Create a Postgres role on a branch. The result includes the new role's password in 'role.password' - the only time Neon returns it. Creating a role drops the connections to the branch's compute.
create_role.display_str_template: Create the role '{2}' on branch {1} of Neon project {0}.
create_role.name: create_role

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.description: What to call the role. At most 63 bytes.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Create a role that owns things or holds privileges but cannot be used to connect. Off by default.
parameters.name: no_login

delete_branch.description: Delete a branch with its databases, roles and computes, and drop its connections. Neon will not delete a project's default or root branch, or a branch that other branches were copied from. A branch that is already gone is reported as 'already_deleted' rather than as an error.
delete_branch.name: delete_branch

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

status.description: 'deleted', or 'already_deleted' if it was already gone.

delete_database.description: Delete a database from a branch, with all of its data on that branch. This cannot be undone. A database that is already gone is reported as 'already_deleted' rather than as an error.
delete_database.display_str_template: Delete the database '{2}' on branch {1} of Neon project {0}.
delete_database.name: delete_database

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.description: The database to delete.
parameters.name: database_name

status.description: 'deleted', or 'already_deleted' if it was already gone.

delete_project.description: Delete a project and everything in it - every branch, database, role and compute - and drop its connections. Neon can recover a deleted project for 7 days, but recovery is not an action here. Returns the project as it was.
delete_project.name: delete_project

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

status.description: 'deleted', or 'already_deleted' if it was already gone.

get_branch.description: Get one branch. Its 'current_state' is 'ready' once Neon has finished creating or resetting it, so a workflow can check this before using the branch.
get_branch.name: get_branch

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

get_connection_uri.description: Get a ready-to-use Postgres connection URI for a database and role, for a later step or an app to connect with. The URI contains the role's password. The branch needs a read-write compute.
get_connection_uri.display_str_template: Get a connection URI for database '{2}' in Neon project {0}.
get_connection_uri.name: get_connection_uri

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch to connect to. Leave blank for the project's default branch.
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.description: The database to connect to.
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.description: The role to connect as.
parameters.name: role_name

parameters.description: Connect through Neon's connection pooler, for serverless code that opens many short connections. Off by default.
parameters.name: pooled

parameters.description: A specific compute to connect through, such as 'ep-cool-darkness-123456' - a read replica, say. Leave blank for the branch's read-write compute.
parameters.name: endpoint_id

uri.description: The Postgres connection URI, including the password.

get_operation.description: Check on one of the operations a change started - every create, delete, rename, reset and password reset returns them in 'operations'. 'done' turns true when it has finished either way and 'succeeded' says which; Neon suggests checking about every 5 seconds.
get_operation.name: get_operation

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The operation's ID, a UUID from an earlier step's 'operations' list, such as 'a07f8772-1877-4da9-a939-3a3ae62d1d8d'.
parameters.name: operation_id

done.description: Whether the operation has finished, either way.

get_project.description: Get a project's settings and this billing period's usage - compute seconds, active seconds, storage, data written and data transferred - for a workflow that watches usage.
get_project.name: get_project

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

list_branches.description: List a project's branches with their state, parent, size and which one is the default. Use it to find a branch's ID, or to tidy up old preview branches.
list_branches.display_str_template: List the branches of Neon project {0}.
list_branches.name: list_branches

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: Only branches whose name or ID contains this.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Defaults to last updated.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Defaults to descending - newest first.
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.description: How many branches to return, 1-1000. Leave blank for every branch.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: To get the next page of branches, paste 'next_cursor' from the previous result here. Leave blank for the first page.
parameters.name: cursor

count.description: How many records this result holds.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as 'Next page' to get the next page, or null.

list_computes.description: List a project's computes (IDs start with 'ep-'), with the branch each serves, its host and its state. 'idle' means scaled to zero, which is normal - it wakes on the next connection.
list_computes.display_str_template: List the computes of Neon project {0}.
list_computes.name: list_computes

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: Only the computes of this branch. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: branch_id

count.description: How many records this result holds.

list_databases.description: List the databases on a branch, with the role that owns each.
list_databases.display_str_template: List the databases on branch {1} of Neon project {0}.
list_databases.name: list_databases

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

count.description: How many records this result holds.

list_organizations.description: List the Neon organizations this API key belongs to, with each one's ID, name and plan. Every Neon project belongs to an organization, and listing or creating projects asks for one. With an organization or project-scoped key it returns the one organization that owns the key.
list_organizations.name: list_organizations

count.description: How many records this result holds.

list_projects.description: List the projects in an organization, with each one's ID, region, Postgres version and when its compute was last active. Projects Neon could not read in time are named in 'unavailable_project_ids' rather than silently left out.
list_projects.display_str_template: List the Neon projects in organization {0}.
list_projects.name: list_projects

parameters.description: The organization whose projects to list.
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.description: Only projects whose name or ID contains this.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: How many projects to return, 1-400. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: To get the next page of projects, paste 'next_cursor' from the previous result here. Leave blank for the first page.
parameters.name: cursor

count.description: How many records this result holds.

has_more.description: Whether another page may follow - true when this page is full.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as 'Next page' to get the next page, or null.

list_roles.description: List the Postgres roles on a branch. Passwords are never included - Neon returns one only when a role is created or its password is reset.
list_roles.display_str_template: List the roles on branch {1} of Neon project {0}.
list_roles.name: list_roles

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

count.description: How many records this result holds.

rename_branch.description: Give a branch a new name. Its ID and data stay the same.
rename_branch.display_str_template: Rename branch {1} of Neon project {0} to '{2}'.
rename_branch.name: rename_branch

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.description: The branch's new name.

source_branch_id.description: The branch the data was restored from.

reset_role_password.description: Give a role a new password, returned in 'role.password'. The old password keeps working until Neon's operation finishes, and connections to the branch's compute drop.
reset_role_password.display_str_template: Reset the password of role '{2}' on branch {1} of Neon project {0}.
reset_role_password.name: reset_role_password

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch. Pick one from the project's branches, or paste a branch ID such as 'br-aged-salad-637688' or its Neon Console URL.

parameters.description: The role whose password to reset.
parameters.name: role_name

restore_branch.description: Replace a branch's data. Leave 'Restore from' blank to reset the branch to its parent's latest data - the usual way to refresh a preview branch. Or pick the branch itself with 'As of' to roll it back to an earlier moment, which needs 'Keep current state as'. The branch's current data is replaced and its connections drop.
restore_branch.name: restore_branch

parameters.description: The Neon project. Pick one from the list, or paste a project ID such as 'bold-cloud-468218' or the project's Neon Console URL.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The branch whose data is replaced.
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.description: The branch to take the data from. Leave blank for this branch's parent.
parameters.name: source_branch_id

parameters.description: Take the data as it was at this moment rather than now. Required when restoring a branch from itself; it has to be inside the history window - 6 hours on the Free plan.
parameters.name: source_timestamp

parameters.description: Instead of 'As of', an exact Postgres log position such as 0/1A2B3C4. Use one or the other.
parameters.name: source_lsn

parameters.description: Save the branch as it is now under this name before restoring. Required when restoring a branch from itself or when other branches were copied from it.
parameters.name: preserve_under_name

source_branch_id.description: The branch the data was restored from.

description: Run Neon serverless Postgres from a workflow: create and delete projects, branch a database for a preview or a test run and reset or roll it back, add databases and roles, and hand the next step a ready-to-use connection string.
